name: farm-buyer-contract-check
description: Check a contract between a farmer and a buyer, processor or contract-farming company before signing: price and how it is set, quality grades and who decides them, volume commitments, rejection and deductions, input credit, payment timing, exclusivity, and what happens after a bad harvest. Use when asked to check this buyer contract, should I sign this contract farming agreement, what does this clause mean for me, the buyer rejected my crop, or is this offtake deal fair. Produces a plain-language summary, a clause-by-clause risk table, questions to ask, changes to request, and a worked example of what the farmer is paid in a good and a bad season. Not legal advice.
